description: This file implements the main React component for the Mind Map page of a career navigation application. It manages state, data fetching from APIs, view interactions such as zoom/pan, node selection, role details, and debugging UI.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Constrains a numeric value within specified min and max bounds.

methods.name: defaultFilters
methods.description: Returns the default filter settings for the mind map view.

methods.name: defaultState
methods.description: Initial default state of the mind map view, including pan, zoom, filters, and selected nodes.

methods.name: toSafeState
methods.description: Sanitizes and converts a raw object into a valid MindmapViewState, applying defaults.

methods.name: safeErrorMessage
methods.description: Converts an unknown error into a user-friendly error message string.

methods.name: getUserKey
methods.description: Generates or retrieves a persistent user key for session tracking, based on persona or anon ID.

methods.name: computeEmptyStateReason
methods.description: Determines the reason why the mind map view is empty, providing user messages for various scenarios.

methods.name: DebugRow
methods.description: React component for displaying debug information rows.
